Scholarship overview

The NUS Integrative Sciences and Engineering Programme supports interdisciplinary PhD research. Applicants compete for admission and scholarship support through the programme, with the August 2027 intake closing in December 2026 and stipend rates differing by citizenship.

Research Areas

  • Interdisciplinary science
  • Engineering
  • Doctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryInternational: SGD 3,900/month; citizens 4,800; PR 4,400
DurationUp to four years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsCompetitive four-year funding; citizenship affects stipend.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round15 December 2026 (August 2027 intake)
LocationSingapore
Details checked9 October 2026

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About National University of Singapore (NUS)

NUS offers graduate research through its faculties and interdisciplinary programmes. The Integrative Sciences and Engineering Programme supports doctoral work across disciplines and has its own scholarship and admission process.
